name: Being Poor
overview: Scripture reveals a compassionate and active response toward the poor as a reflection of honoring God, who hears and delivers those in need. Believers are commanded not to harden their hearts or withhold help from their impoverished brethren, recognizing that oppressing the poor is equivalent to reproaching the Creator. The righteous are called to mercy, delivering and protecting the vulnerable, and God promises to hear their cries and save them from troubles. Additionally, godly provision extends beyond immediate relief, as a good man leaves an inheritance for future generations, demonstrating stewardship aligned with divine justice.
